2608.03898.title: ANNOTARES: A Dataset for Extracting Logical Structures from German Statutory Texts
2608.03898.paper_summary: The automatic structural analysis of legal texts is a cornerstone of legal technology, yet the extraction of their logical components remains a significant challenge. In this paper, we introduce the task of identifying and segmenting legal conditions (Tatbestand) and legal consequences (Rechtsfolge) within German statutory texts. To support this task, we present ANNOTARES (Annotations of Tatbestand-Rechtsfolge Sequences), a novel dataset comprising German law texts with span-level annotations. Spanning three distinct legal codes, the dataset is designed to evaluate both domain-specific performance and cross-statute generalizability. We benchmark diverse architectural approaches: a rule-based baseline, CRFs, BiLSTMs, BiLSTM-CRF, and modern Transformer-based models, including BERT variants and LLM-based methods. Our results demonstrate that BERT and LLM-based models achieve superior performance in capturing the complex syntactic structures of legal language. We release our dataset to facilitate further research in automated legal reasoning.
2608.03898.paper_summary_zh: 法律文本的自動結構分析是法律科技的基石，但提取其邏輯組件仍然是一個重大挑戰。在本文中，我們介紹了識別和分段德國法定文本中的法律條件（Tatbestand）和法律後果（Rechtsfolge）的任務。為了支持這一任務，我們提出了ANNOTARES（Tatbestand-Rechtsfolge序列的註釋），這是一個包含德國法律文本的全新數據集，並附有範圍級註釋。該數據集涵蓋三個不同的法律法典，旨在評估特定領域的表現和跨法典的通用性。我們基準測試了多種架構方法：基於規則的基線、CRFs、BiLSTMs、BiLSTM-CRF以及包括BERT變體和基於LLM的方法在內的現代Transformer模型。我們的結果顯示，BERT和基於LLM的模型在捕捉法律語言的複雜句法結構方面表現優越。我們發布了我們的數據集，以促進自動法律推理的進一步研究。
